Recycle your wedding dress at every occasion! The way your great great grandma used to.[/size][/center]


[u][center]Quick Start[/center][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Unzip this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder, if you are confused see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿
[*]It's ready to play!
[*]Buy the hand mirror from Pierre's shop, or select "start with hand mirror" when creating a new farm
[*]Select the hand mirror tool and then click anywhere on your screen

[/list]
[u][center]Credits[/center][/u]
The spotty top and dress are inspired by the dress Maru wears in [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/1073356-diverse-stardew-valley-sebastian-maru-robin-and-demetrius-dsv-seasonal-outfits]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url]﻿ as designed by DesertDove. I have permissions! And I have much love for Wabi, for helping me with the formatting of this mod.
